❖ How to Import directly into Figma

Method 1: Instant Clipboard Copy (Fastest)

Click "Copy SVG" on any vector card below, switch to your Figma canvas, and press Cmd + V. Figma immediately instantiates native editable vector layers, frames, texts, and icons!

Method 2: Bulk Drag & Drop Files

Unzip pos-bits-ui-screens.zip. Select any or all files from Finder, and drag-and-drop them right onto your Figma project canvas. They will arrange as clean artboard frames.

Method 3: Cross-Reference Designs

Switch to the "Original Reference (54)" tab below to compare the original pixel-perfect reference designs with the vector screens side-by-side.
